title: The Pot on Top
lines: Mom sat a tin pot on top.
A tot is at the pot.
Tip! Pop! The pot is not on top.
Mom, a mop! Tom, a mop!
Mop it, Tom. Mop, mop, mop.
Mom sat the tin pot on top.
Sit on the mat, tot! Sit and pat it.
Mom and Tom pat the tot.

questions.ask: Who tipped the pot off the top?
questions.listenFor: The tot, the little one. Lines two and three tell the story of it. Let your child read them again if they are unsure.

questions.ask: What did Mom and Tom use to clean it up?
questions.listenFor: A mop. One word is plenty. If your child is stuck, ask what Mom called for right after the pot went pop.

questions.ask: Do you think the tot will go for the pot again? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is good. You are listening for a reason from the story, like the pot is back up on top, or tots always try again.
